L27n892.name: Name syllable to LaTeX
L27n892.description: Fires on the opening syllable of a split name (Ne-, Bre-, Re-); pushes toward $-delimited math variables.

L27n390.name: Word piece to equals
L27n390.description: Fires on mid-word pieces and Georgian fragments; pushes toward equals-sign tokens such as =A and =B.

L27n1672.name: Name start to quotes
L27n1672.description: Negative pole fires on name openers and prepositions (of, for); pushes toward closing-quote and paren tokens.

L27n1161.name: Name stem before fixed phrase
L27n1161.description: Fires on the stem before a fixed name or phrase (Cooperative, Par-, Rio de, Granada); pushes toward 'extension'.

L27n620.name: Determiner before modifier, writes adjectives
L27n620.description: Fires on 'a', 'his', 'my' before a modifier (a new world record, a substantive bill); pushes toward intensity adjectives like 'robust' and 'rigorous'.
